* '''Race:''' [[Beast]]s

Leopards are a specific sub race of cats that have adepted to the cold climate of the mountain landscape of Dun Morogh, they are also known as [[Snow Leopard]] which suggests other leopards also exist on [[Azeroth]].

=Hunter=

[[Hunter]]s in [[World of Warcraft]] have the ability to tame certain [[beast]]s.

* '''Tamable:''' Yes (Cat family)
* '''Diet:''' Fish, Meat
* '''Skills:''' Bite, Claw, Dash, Prowl

* '''Damage:''' +10%
* '''Armour:''' -5%
* '''Health:''' -2%
